name: Legal Review
description: Performs a legal review on a document, appends redlines and reasoning to the bottom, and generates a structured summary document.

steps.title: Analyze Document
steps.description: Read the target document using docs-cat and analyze it for legal risks, structural concerns, and necessary redlines.

steps.title: Append Redlines & Reasoning
steps.description: Using docs-write --append, inject a [LEGAL REVIEW REDLINES] section at the bottom of the target document containing the redlines and the reasoning for each.

steps.title: Notify via Comment
steps.description: Using docs-comments-add, leave a document-level comment pointing the author to the appended redlines.

steps.title: Generate Summary Document
steps.description: Using docs-create and docs-write, generate a final summary document. Ensure it follows this strict structure: ## Review Scope, ## Key Findings, ## Structural/Risk Concerns, ## Redline Summary.

steps.title: Verify Execution
steps.description: Verify that a summary document was created with the required headers and that redlines were appended to the original document.
